Create exactly five isolated orthographic Flooded Works terrain chunk directions on a removable flat magenta background: four solid masses with wide-low, medium-low, medium-mid, and medium-tall proportions plus one very wide thin catwalk; common flat palette/light direction, no outlines, labels, noise, tiny repeated details, or tile-grid seams.
